UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Owner-scoped player profile, game preferences, and lifetime match scoreboard stats.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Editable fighter display name shown on the Title Screen account bar.

favoriteFighter.description: Default fighter selected automatically on sign-in.

defaultMap.description: Default arena stage or random stage preference.

preferredMode.description: Preferred battle mode on the Title Screen.

scoreboard.description: Nested map containing p1, p2, and cpu records with integer wins, losses, and currentStreak.

onlineStats.description: Optional nested map containing casualWins, casualLosses, rankedWins, rankedLosses, rankedPoints, and rankedStreak.

tournamentStats.description: Optional nested map tracking bi-weekly 7-day tournament cycleId, points, wins, losses, streak, bestPoints, careerWins, careerLosses, and trophies.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile or scoreboard update.

UserPrivateAccount.title: UserPrivateAccount
UserPrivateAccount.description: Strictly isolated PII and authentication provider metadata for the account owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

email.description: Account email address (empty string for guest or email-less providers).

isGuest.description: Whether the account is currently an anonymous guest session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest login or provider update.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only player profile, fighter/stage preferences, and cloud-synced lifetime scoreboard.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Owner-only isolated PII document (docId: account) storing email and login provider metadata.
